les: Klein prentjies wat vir regte dinge staan
kaps_punt: Simbole en Sleutels — Simbole soos eenvoudige prente of letters; Simbole op 'n eenvoudige grootskaalkaart; Sleutels, as lys van simbole, met hul betekenisse op Suid-Afrikaanse kaarte; Lees van 'n kaart op 'n plaas, boeredorpie of deel van dorp deur van simbole en sleutel gebruik te maak; Teken of voltooiing van eie kaart deur van simbole en sleutel gebruik te maak

items.bewering: Kyk na 'n kaart en jy sien klein prentjies en lyne daarop. Elkeen van hulle staan vir iets wat op daardie plek is.
items.bron: Ordnance Survey, Legend 1:50 000 scale (version 2022-01, ordnancesurvey.co.uk/documents/50k-raster-legend.pdf): the key lists lines and marks that stand for nothing physical at that spot, such as boundary lines (national, county, district) and 'Graticule intersection at 5' intervals'. QGIS Gentle GIS Introduction, ch. 9 Map Production (docs.qgis.org): a map also carries a north arrow, a scale bar and a grid of reference lines, which are drawn on the map but are not features at a place.
items.regstelling: The quantifier 'elkeen' is too strong. Not every small picture or line on a map stands for something at that place: the north arrow (a small picture), the scale bar and grid lines (lines) and borders are on maps too, and learners meet the north arrow and grid squares in this same map-skills topic. Read with 'elkeen', a learner can conclude that a grid line or a border, or later the equator, is something real on the ground, which is a known misconception. Narrow the quantifier and keep the rest of the sentence, for example 'Die meeste van hulle staan vir iets wat regtig op daardie plek is.'

items.bewering: So 'n prentjie, teken, letter of kleur noem ons 'n simbool.
items.bron: Ordnance Survey, Guide to cartography: Symbology (docs.os.uk): features are shown as points, lines or areas styled with colour, size and pattern, with text labels; conventional and mimetic (picture-like) symbols. OS 1:50 000 legend: letter abbreviations (Sch, Hospl, PH) stand in the key as symbols.

items.bewering: Die lyn vir 'n pad is nie self 'n klein paadjie nie. Die lyn staan net vir die pad wat daar loop.
items.bron: OS 1:50 000 legend (roads drawn as coloured lines by road class); gisgeography.com 'Map scale' / generalisation: roads are shown as single lines that stand for the road. The mapping holds: the line represents the road, it is not a small version of it.

items.bewering: Simbole maak 'n kaart makliker om te lees as 'n bladsy vol woorde.
items.bron: Ordnance Survey, Guide to cartography: Symbology (docs.os.uk): conventional and mimetic symbols make features identifiable at a glance, and showing everything in full would be 'really cluttered and confusing'.

items.bewering: 'n Simbool sê nie altyd self wat hy beteken nie. Op die een kaart beteken 'n groen kol dalk 'n park. Op 'n ander kaart beteken dieselfde groen kol dalk 'n bos.
items.blok: Die sleutel sê wat die simbole beteken
items.bron: OpenStreetMap Wiki, Tag:leisure=park: parks render light green in OSM-based maps. Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend: woods are the green fill, while 'Park or ornamental ground' is grey. So the same green means a park on one map and a wood on another. Esri ArcUser, 'Five primary design principles for cartography': geometric symbols are ambiguous and need a legend.

items.bewering: Die sleutel op die kaart is 'n lys van die simbole met hul betekenisse.
items.blok: Die sleutel sê wat die simbole beteken
items.bron: QGIS Gentle GIS Introduction ch. 9 (docs.qgis.org): the legend explains what the symbols, colours and patterns on the map mean; Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend as a worked example.

items.bewering: Die mense wat die kaart maak, kies self watter simbole hulle gebruik.
items.blok: Die sleutel sê wat die simbole beteken
items.bron: Ordnance Survey, Guide to cartography: Symbology (docs.os.uk): 'It's a cartographer's job to decide how each feature is represented.' National mapping agencies set their own conventions (OS, and CD: National Geo-spatial Information's Map Design project which redesigned SA symbols, GISSA presentation T. Rambau 2021), which is consistent with the claim.

items.bewering: Op 'n eenvoudige kaart met prentjies staan 'n klein huisie vir 'n regte huis.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: Ordnance Survey, Guide to cartography: Symbology: mimetic symbols 'look like the object they are representing'. A house drawn as a little house on a simple picture map is a mimetic symbol.

items.bewering: 'n Boompie staan dikwels vir bome of 'n bos.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend: coniferous, non-coniferous and mixed wood are shown with small tree symbols on a green fill; mapserve.co.uk 'OS map symbols': woodland is 'green fills and symbols'.

items.bewering: 'n Pad word gewoonlik as 'n lyn geteken.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend, 'Roads and paths': every road class and path is a line symbol.

items.bewering: 'n Skool het op baie kaarte sy eie simbool.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend, Abbreviations: 'Sch School'. The lesson itself counts a letter as a symbol, so a letter abbreviation qualifies. OS Explorer 1:25 000 legend also lists School.

items.bewering: 'n Hospitaal kry ook dikwels 'n eie simbool.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: OpenStreetMap Wiki, Tag:amenity=hospital: OSM Carto renders a dedicated hospital icon. Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend: 'Hospl Hospital'. OS Symbology guide: a red cross for a hospital is its example of a conventional symbol.

items.bewering: 'n Plek van aanbidding, soos 'n kerk, kry ook dikwels sy eie simbool.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend, Land features: 'Place of worship' and 'Current or former place of worship with tower / with spire, minaret or dome' each have their own symbol. OpenStreetMap Wiki, Tag:amenity=place_of_worship: OSM Carto draws a symbol per religion plus a generic one.

items.bewering: Op baie kaarte staan die letter P vir 'n parkeerplek.
items.blok: Simbole wat 'n mens op baie kaarte kry
items.bron: OpenStreetMap Wiki, Tag:amenity=parking: the standard map 'renders the "P" logo'. Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 legend, Tourist information: 'Parking' is a white P on a blue square. Not a fault, but for the writer's awareness: in the same OS key the plain letter P in the abbreviations list means Post office, which shows why the lesson's 'read the key first' matters. 'Op baie kaarte' stays true.

items.bewering: Lees eers die sleutel van 'n plaas se kaart. Nou weet jy watter simbool die plaashuis is en watter een die pad is. Jy kry ook die bome en die dam daarop. 'n Kraal of 'n stal naby die huis wys waar die diere bly.
items.bron: Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'kraal' (South African English): an area fenced in for keeping animals, e.g. a cattle kraal; Wikipedia 'Kraal': the proper referent is the animal pen within a homestead. 'Stal': a building where animals are housed (vocabulary.com Dutch dictionary, 'stal': verblijf voor dieren; cowshed). The block describes one example farm map, not every farm, so 'naby die huis' and 'die dam' are not general claims.

items.bewering: Op 'n kaart van 'n boeredorpie kry jy die skool en die kerk.
items.bron: Franco Frescura, 'Village development patterns: Karoo' (sahistory.org.za): colonial villages 'usually grown up round the Dutch Church as a nucleus' (John Mackenzie, 1859). NWU repository study on Eastern Cape Midlands towns: second-phase towns were founded by the Dutch Reformed Church, e.g. Burgersdorp (1846). A church and a school are standard features of a South African farming town.

items.bewering: 'n Kaart van 'n deel van 'n dorp wys 'n klein gebied.
items.bron: gisgeography.com 'Map scale' and askaboutireland.ie 'Scale': a large-scale map shows a small area such as a town or campus in great detail.

items.bewering: Die sleutel help jou om die hospitaal en die park daarop te vind. Die deel met die fabrieke kry dikwels sy eie kleur op die kaart.
items.bron: Land-use colour conventions: the US Land-Based Classification Standards colour industrial and manufacturing activity purple, and Austin and Philadelphia city planning land-use charts do the same. San Francisco uses blue/grey and Michigan State University guidance uses red, so the colour varies but industrial areas commonly get their own colour. 'Dikwels' is correctly hedged.

items.bewering: 'n Goeie simbool is eenvoudig en maklik om te teken. 'n Mens moet die betekenis maklik kan raai, selfs sonder die sleutel. Die sleutel sê dan of jy reg geraai het.
items.bron: Ordnance Survey Symbology guide: conventional and mimetic symbols make features identifiable 'without them needing to refer to the legend'. MDPI IJGI 12(7):254 (2023), tourist-map symbol study: symbols that look little like their object perform poorly, and the most readable symbols depict the object directly (Ratajski; MacEachren). ICC 2015 'Pictorial symbols design based on the Gestalt theory' recommends simple graphic content.

items.bewering: 'n Boompie vir 'n bos werk beter as 'n ingewikkelde prentjie.
items.bron: Esri ArcUser, 'Make maps people want to look at': simple symbols stay readable at small sizes, and detail must fall as symbols get smaller. decorative-maps.com 'Principles of good symbol design': smaller symbols demand less detail. OS legend: woods are shown with small, simple tree marks.

items.bewering: As jou simbole in 'n sleutel staan, kan iemand anders jou kaart makliker lees.
items.bron: QGIS Gentle GIS Introduction ch. 9 (docs.qgis.org): the legend exists so a reader can decode the symbols, colours and patterns used.

items.bewering: simbool: Iets wat vir iets anders staan, soos 'n prentjie, 'n letter of 'n kleur.
items.bron: Ordnance Survey Symbology guide (symbols as styled points, lines and areas with colour; conventional and mimetic symbols); OS 1:50 000 legend (letter abbreviations used as symbols). Accurate at Grade 4 level and consistent with the study text.

items.bewering: sleutel: 'n Lys op 'n kaart wat verduidelik wat die simbole daarop beteken.
items.bron: QGIS Gentle GIS Introduction ch. 9 (docs.qgis.org): the legend (key) explains what the map's symbols, colours and patterns mean; University of Twente ITC Living Textbook, 'Map legend'.

opsomming: One claim needs narrowing: the opening block says EVERY small picture and line on a map stands for something at that place, but the north arrow, scale bar, grid lines and borders do not and learners meet them in this same topic; every other claim is confirmed, the lesson has no superlatives, and its one comparison (a road line versus a road) maps correctly.
